regions.region: page 2 article title, author block, abstract, and ESI availability line
regions.finding: The true title was read as 'Pd-catalyzed coupling reaction of cyclobutanols with propargylic carbonates'. The paper mentions ESI, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

One current-paper 1a/2a experiment uses Pd(dba)2/XPhos in toluene under Ar, 50 °C/21 h then 80 °C/7 h, giving 3aa in 28% NMR yield with 46% 2a recovery. Ordered temperature stages were retained separately.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion narrative and Table 1 header
regions.finding: The eleven base-screening conditions are introduced here and completed on page 3. The fresh-2a/no-base 3 h run remains distinct; exact cross-listed standard rows are merged only where substrate, conditions, and outcomes coincide.

unresolved: Scheme 1 omits absolute scale and solvent volume.
The ESI statement does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.finding: Eleven base-screening rows were retained with exact scale, base identity/loading, toluene volume, 80 °C/6 h or fresh-2a 3 h override, NMR yield/complicated outcome, recovery or dash marker, and CH2Br2 basis.

Ten ligand conditions were reconciled; entries 1–9 are independent records, while XPhos entry 10 is merged with identical Table 1 entry 3/Table 3 entry 1. Complicated rows, zero-yield/no-product rows, and recovery remain distinct source outcomes.
Pd(OAc)2, PdCl2, and Pd(TFA)2 rows are separate experiments; Pd(dba)2 entry 1 is the same standard condition cross-listed in Tables 1/2/3 and is not triplicated.

THF, dioxane, CH3CN, DCM, and DMF rows are separate. The scheme/narrative says K3PO4·3H2O, but footnote a prints K2CO3; both source statements are retained. DMF is complicated with 14% 3aa and a recovery dash.
Introduces Table 5 and also reports a distinct 60 °C/1 mmol-scale attempt with minor 2a recovery. The latter remains separate from the 0.20 mmol Table 5 row.

unresolved: Table 4 footnote conflicts with its scheme/narrative on base identity.
The narrative 1 mmol-scale 60 °C trial omits exact charges, time, product yield, and quantitative recovery.
Table dashes were preserved rather than forced to zero.

regions.finding: Four temperature rows were reconciled; 80 °C entry 1 is merged with identical Table 1 entry 5/Table 4 entry 1. Entries 2–4 remain distinct. The K3PO4·3H2O scheme versus K2CO3 footnote conflict is retained.

Eleven independent 1a–1k scope arrows were retained with row time, yield, 1.2/1.0 mmol scale, catalyst/ligand footnote overrides, and the 4% NMR 1,3-diphenylpropadiene byproduct targeted to the 3aa run.
One 1l experiment gives proximal-cleavage product 3la in 51% after 18 h; distal-cleavage 3la' is explicitly not observed and remains an outcome of the same run.
The failed R1=H and 2-substituted cyclobutanol results continue as two distinct Scheme 4 experiments on page 5 and are linked cross-page rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table 5 base identity conflicts between scheme and footnote.
Scope-scheme yield bases, workups, purifications, and masses are generally not stated.
Compact scope structures remain machine candidates or label-only.

regions.finding: The 1m run is one three-product experiment: expected 3ma 0%, 3ma' 25%, and 3ma'' 27% by NMR. The separate 1n run reports no reaction and 60% NMR recovery of 2a.
Eleven independent 2b–2l arrows were retained with row time/yield, catalyst/ligand loading overrides, and amount overrides. The <5% 3al result remains an upper-bound NMR yield rather than zero.

A distinct 6.0 mmol 1a/5.0 mmol 2f gram-scale run gives 1.2305 g product in 66% isolated yield. The drawing labels 2f→3af, while prose says 3ab; both labels are preserved as an unresolved source conflict.
The 0.5 mmol 3af transformation to 4 uses NaBH4 1.5 equiv/MeOH with printed 0 °C/5 min, 60 °C/10 min, and room-temperature/Ar/5 h stages, retained as ordered steps; product yield is 93%.

The 0.5 mmol 3af transformation uses PPh3(CH3)Br and n-BuLi (1.5 equiv each) in THF, printed 0 °C/40 min + 10 min then room temperature/Ar/12 h, giving 5 in 50%. The two zero-degree periods and untimed warming transition remain separate.

unresolved: The Wittig graphic does not narrate the exact operation assigned to each 0 °C period; the stage assignment remains unreviewed.
